top_comments.author: @CircuitSage-d5e
top_comments.text: Honestly, I wouldn't call this an insurance problem. No execution logs means you shipped a prototype. Fix observability before deploying near real money.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Exactly — calling it an insurance issue misses the point. If you don’t have execution logs you’re basically running a demo in production, especially anywhere real money moves. Get observability solid first, then talk about deployment. What’s been the biggest gap you’ve seen teams struggle with there — tracing, replay, or just getting anyone to care before something breaks?
